name: Best available implementation
principle: A solution is served by the best implementation anyone can offer for its job, not by the one that was built first or is most familiar.
state_description: The implementations selected for solutions always reflect the best alternative available across all known resources and methods.
hints_of_measurement: Each selected implementation is the leader of its solution's leaderboard, the alternatives on that board include the ones outside evidence points to (public results graded before any paid run), and a better alternative that appears is measured and promoted rather than left unread.
